nodes.meaning: A person or owner-qualified process that evaluates candidate evidence without receiving authority from the compiler.
One exact immutable Lean declaration identity including commit, path, blob, kind, qualified name, line, and line digest.
One proposed directed source-kind, predicate, target-kind triple with exact supporting declaration bindings.
Requires one exact candidate edge, expected direction rule, frozen source commit, and supporting declaration bindings.
Returns deterministic status, rejection codes, resolved selector identities, input digest, and authority effect none.
Rejects source drift, missing selectors, wrong direction, unknown fields, and every requested authority effect other than none.
Requires exact source closure, deterministic evaluation, direction sensitivity, non-authority, and explicit residue.
A passing candidate evidence result that may be reviewed but is not accepted, admitted, promoted, or executable.
